description: Golden set of 5 representative requirement scenarios for evaluating pipeline output quality. Run via eval/score.py after any prompt/model change.

cases.input: As a customer I can view my order status. AC: returns 200 with status for a valid order id; returns 404 for unknown id.
As a user I can reset my password via email link. AC: link expires after 15 minutes; invalid token returns 400.
As an admin I can deactivate a user account. AC: deactivated users cannot log in; returns 403 on login attempt.
As a customer I can apply a discount code at checkout. AC: valid code reduces total; expired code returns an error message; invalid code returns 422.
As a user I can upload a profile picture. AC: only jpg/png under 5MB accepted; oversized or wrong format returns 400 with a clear message.

scoring_rules: Each required field must be present and non-null/non-empty (schema check via scripts/validator.py).
acceptance_criteria count must meet or exceed min_acceptance_criteria.
title must contain the expected keyword (case-insensitive) — checks grounding to the original requirement.
No fabricated acceptance criteria beyond what the input states (manual spot-check for PASS cases).
